overview.title: What changed, and what it rests on
overview.intro: A privacy-preserving view of acquisition, service delivery, and learning outcomes. Every number is cohort-based and traceable to first-party operational records.

funnel.title: The path into sustained learning
funnel.intro: Unique rotating first-party subject keys only. A later step counts after its prerequisite step; retention requires the full elapsed interval.

operational.title: Service health
operational.intro: Attendance, responsiveness, capacity, and financial reliability from ordinary transactional records.

tutorAttendanceRate.label: Tutor attendance
tutorAttendanceRate.detail: Tutor join records across lessons where a tutor was expected.

studentAttendanceRate.label: Student attendance
studentAttendanceRate.detail: Present or late attendance across expected student places.

missingFeedbackRate.label: Missing feedback
missingFeedbackRate.detail: Completed lessons without published structured feedback.

cancellationRate.label: Cancellations
cancellationRate.detail: Canceled lessons as a share of lessons due in the period.

supportResolutionRate.label: Support resolved
supportResolutionRate.detail: Tickets opened in the period that reached resolved or closed.

supportResolutionHours.label: Resolution time
supportResolutionHours.detail: Mean elapsed time from ticket creation to resolution.

utilizationRate.label: Tutor utilization
utilizationRate.detail: Delivered lesson minutes against recorded available minutes.

marginPerLesson.label: Margin per lesson
marginPerLesson.detail: Captured lesson revenue less tutor earning, never mixed across currencies.

paymentFailureRate.label: Payment failures
paymentFailureRate.detail: Failed charges across completed or failed charge attempts.

refundRate.label: Refunds
refundRate.detail: Completed refunds as a share of successful charge attempts.

academic.title: Learning evidence
academic.intro: Cohort aggregates describe observed progress without ranking a child, predicting a grade, or turning attention into a score.

baselineScore.label: Baseline
baselineScore.detail: Mean first diagnostic score for learners with a follow-up.

followUpScore.label: Follow-up
followUpScore.detail: Mean latest diagnostic score for the same learner cohort.

milestoneCompletionRate.label: Milestones completed
milestoneCompletionRate.detail: Evidence-backed completed milestones across included milestones.

planProgressRate.label: Plan progress
planProgressRate.detail: Completed learning-plan items across active plan items.

accuracyTrend.label: Accuracy trend
accuracyTrend.detail: Latest minus first normalized assessment accuracy by learner and subject.

rubricImprovement.label: Rubric improvement
rubricImprovement.detail: Latest minus first normalized score by learner and rubric criterion.

selfReportedSchoolPerformance.label: Self-reported school performance
selfReportedSchoolPerformance.detail: Learner-reported value only; this is not an observed or predicted grade.

privacy.title: The analytics boundary
privacy.body: Direct identifiers are removed from reports, cohorts smaller than {count} are suppressed, and responses are private and non-cacheable.
privacy.never: Never collected here: advertising identifiers, precise location, biometrics, device fingerprints, or manipulative attention analytics. Child learning data is never combined with an advertising profile.
